audience: merchants and finance teams who take card and PayPal payments with Braintree

useCases.title: Find failed or unsettled payments in a date range
useCases.text: The AI searches transactions by created-at range and status, such as failed or still waiting to settle. You get the amount, status and date of each one, and a total.

useCases.title: Look into one transaction and its customer
useCases.text: The AI opens a transaction to read its amount, status, order id and linked customer. Then it opens that customer, including the name and company.

useCases.title: Check a customer's saved payment methods
useCases.text: The AI lists the vaulted cards and PayPal accounts of one customer, with usage and created-at date. You can see what is on file.

useCases.title: Trace a customer's recurring charges
useCases.text: The AI lists a customer's transactions to follow repeated charges by status, amount and date. It does not read subscription objects, because the GraphQL API does not expose them.

useCases.title: Refund or void a transaction
useCases.text: The AI refunds a settled transaction in full or in part, or voids one that has not settled yet. Refunds return money and voids cancel unsettled payments, so check the transaction first.
